title: Replace outbox_processor.dart's raw 'sync_outbox_push_failed' literal with a LogEvents catalog constant
why: log_events.dart's own header says every AppLogger call site MUST use a constant from that file rather than an ad-hoc string literal, but both AppLogger.instance.warning(...) calls here hand-type 'sync_outbox_push_failed' — a name distinct from the catalog's existing sync_push_failed. Two divergent event names now exist for 'a sync push failed'; anyone querying structured logs by the catalog constant misses these two sites, and renaming pushFailed's value later won't touch them.
recommendation: Either reuse LogEvents.sync.pushFailed (if semantically equivalent) or add `String get outboxPushFailed => 'sync_outbox_push_failed';` to _SyncEvents and reference it from both call sites.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -n "event: '" lib/core/sync/outbox/outbox_processor.dart` returns no bare string-literal event names.
